pages.title: Beach Volleyball Clash: Summer Smash
pages.creator: Imagine World Studios
pages.description: Play arcade volleyball on the sand in Beach Volleyball Clash: Summer Smash. Spike, dive, and block against the computer or other players, with team matches also available. Strike glowing orbs to charge special throws, including fire, ice, and multiball attacks that change the next rally.

pages.title: Zombie Conquer Countries
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Expand an infected army across a world map in Zombie Conquer Countries. Begin with a small group of zombies and send them into cities to spread the infection. Each successful takeover increases your numbers and opens the way to claiming more territory.

pages.title: Meme Mukbang ASMR Game
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Build a food-streaming audience in Meme Mukbang ASMR Game. Prepare dishes such as noodles and seafood, then eat them during the character's livestreams. Interact with viewers and earn in-game income as the channel's following grows through more cooking and eating sessions.

pages.title: Jungle Match Adventures
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Explore a rainforest with Aria in Jungle Match Adventures. Combine at least three matching jungle pieces to clear them and fulfill the current board's objective. Completing stages takes the explorer deeper into the forest, where treasures, relics, and gems form part of the adventure.

pages.title: Solitaire Klondike: Eternal Russian Classic
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Clear a classic card deal in Solitaire Klondike: Eternal Russian Classic. Build four suit foundations from ace through king, rearranging the seven tableau columns in descending order with alternating colors. Reveal more cards and use the available spaces to work toward moving the whole deck onto the foundations.

pages.title: Marshmallow Rush
pages.creator: Raccoon
pages.description: Build a rising stack during a one-button run in Marshmallow Rush. Tap at the right moment to add marshmallows, pass the course's obstacles, and gather boosters. Keep the tower growing as you approach the finish and aim for a better result on the next run.

pages.title: Jetstream Escape
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Pilot a fast boat through pursuit sequences in Jetstream Escape. Steer through the water while avoiding coast guards and escaping the storms along the route. Use the directional controls to make room between threats and keep the boat moving through the chase.

pages.title: Celebrity Wednesday Addams Style
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Create gothic-inspired outfits in Celebrity Wednesday Addams Style. Browse dark clothing and matching accessories to give the characters looks influenced by Wednesday's style. Choose combinations for each celebrity character and finish the makeover with the details that suit the outfit.

pages.title: Car Dealer Idle
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Run a vehicle business in Car Dealer Idle. Buy and sell cars, develop the showroom, and unlock more selling booths as the operation grows. Reinvest the dealership's income in improvements that make room for further vehicles and another stage of expansion.

pages.title: Golf Mini
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Complete small courses in as few shots as possible in Golf Mini. Aim the ball toward the hole while accounting for obstacles and traps along the route. Each level presents a different layout, so plan where a stroke will leave the ball before taking the next one.

pages.title: Pool Merge Mania
pages.creator: Orenji Spark
pages.description: Shoot numbered balls onto a pool-style table in Pool Merge Mania. Colliding matches combine into higher-level balls, changing the arrangement for later shots. Keep the table below its fifteen-ball limit by choosing angles that create merges instead of filling every available space.

pages.title: Bffs Cherry Blossom Celebration
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Dress a group of friends for spring in Bffs Cherry Blossom Celebration. Choose pastel clothing, floral details, and accessories inspired by the blooming trees. Put together a separate look for each friend so the group is ready to celebrate among the cherry blossoms.

pages.title: Burger Tycoon
pages.creator: Infinity Loop
pages.description: Develop a fast-food restaurant in Burger Tycoon. Move around the business to prepare burgers, serve customers, and keep the operation running. Hire staff, improve the kitchen, and expand the restaurant as the earnings support more equipment and a larger flow of orders.

pages.title: Sprunki Coloring Book
pages.creator: Caner
pages.description: Color character pictures and scenes in Sprunki Coloring Book. Choose a design, pick the colors you want, and fill its different sections. Work through the details to create your own version of the Sprunki-themed artwork before selecting another picture to paint.

pages.title: 3D Match Puzzle Mania
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Collect sets of three objects in 3D Match Puzzle Mania. Tap identical items in the three-dimensional pile to remove them and work toward the level's goal. Earn coins for power-ups and complete daily tasks to gain more bonuses for later puzzles.

pages.title: Card Battle
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Prepare a fighting group through card choices in Card Battle. Select cards that add weapons, equipment, or more fighters, then face the opposing force. Upgrade coin earnings or strength between battles and unlock additional cards to expand the options available for your next lineup.

pages.title: Phone Case Diy 5
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Decorate a three-dimensional phone cover in Phone Case Diy 5. Choose patterns, stickers, and other embellishments, combining them into a customized case design. Compare how the details sit on the cover and finish with a style assembled from your selected decorations.

pages.title: Insta Trends Galaxy Fashion
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Create space-inspired outfits for five princesses in Insta Trends Galaxy Fashion. Browse the wardrobe for Elsa, Anna, Moana, Ariel, and Rapunzel, combining clothing with matching accessories. Give each character a completed look for their fashion adventure on Planet Her.

pages.title: Save The Piggies
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Clear an animal-filled enclosure in Save The Piggies. Click a pig to make it move forward, choosing an order that lets the animals leave without blocking one another. Later arrangements contain larger groups, requiring you to plan more of the escape sequence in advance.

pages.title: Balls2048
pages.creator: DAPALAB
pages.description: Combine equal-numbered balls in Balls2048. Slide matching values together to form larger numbers, building from small balls toward 2048. Think about the next available matches before committing a move so the developing layout supports another useful combination.

pages.title: Mahjong Frenzy
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Remove matching tile pairs in Mahjong Frenzy. Search the board for identical pieces and select them to clear the layout. Finish the whole arrangement to complete its puzzle, then return for additional challenges and the rewards offered by the daily progression.

pages.title: Tanks of the Galaxy
pages.creator: 9Lives Games
pages.description: Drive a tank into top-down combat in Tanks of the Galaxy. Fire at enemy tanks, dodge their shots, and use shields or the surroundings to stay alive. Earn coins during battles and spend them on tank improvements and more powerful weapons for later encounters.

pages.title: Real Drift Multiplayer 2
pages.creator: Rokito Games
pages.description: Slide cars through races in Real Drift Multiplayer 2. Choose solo driving or an online multiplayer session, then control the vehicle through sustained drifts. Use the steering keys and activate nitro when more speed is needed to continue the run through the course.

pages.title: Art Thief 3D
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Send a crew to dismantle pixel artwork in Art Thief 3D. Aim and throw a die to create as many workers as its rolled value. The workers collect colored cubes from the picture and carry them back to your base, gradually removing the larger image.

pages.title: Build Dance Bot
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Assemble a mechanical performer in Build Dance Bot. Fit the robot's legs, arms, body, head, and additional components into place to complete the construction. Once the parts are attached, watch the finished dance bot perform its routine.

pages.title: Hunter Hitman
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Stalk armed enemies with a knife in Hunter Hitman. Approach targets quietly and eliminate them, chaining rapid takedowns into combos. Collect coins and character cards to unlock more skins while working through the areas that need to be cleared of opponents.

pages.title: DoodieMan Apocalypse
pages.creator: KukoGames
pages.description: Clear a city of bandits in DoodieMan Apocalypse. Aim the character's unconventional projectiles at enemies placed around each stage, choosing a trajectory that reaches them. Complete the required takedowns to advance into levels with more opponents to hit.

pages.title: Om Nom Bounce
pages.creator: Zeptolab UK Limited
pages.description: Help Om Nom defeat enemies with bouncing candy in Om Nom Bounce. Hold to aim a shot, then release and use the rebounds to reach opponents and bosses. Upgrade the character while progressing through forty levels across four different environments.

pages.title: Skates Sky Roller
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Adjust your skates to fit the route in Skates Sky Roller. Change their position as obstacles approach so the rider can pass through the available spaces. Collect additional skateboards along the course and keep adapting the stance until you reach the finish.

pages.title: Wild Animal Transport Truck
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Deliver zoo animals in Wild Animal Transport Truck. Drive the loaded vehicle along the marked route and park at the destination before time expires. Ten assignments require steady handling so the animal transport reaches its drop-off point safely.

pages.title: MineWar Soldiers vs Zombies
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description: Deploy a block-style army in MineWar Soldiers vs Zombies. Choose soldiers with shooting or close-combat abilities and position them to stop the undead advance. Gather coins and diamonds left by defeated enemies to call in more troops and strengthen the line.

pages.title: Shumujong
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Clear numbered tiles by adding their values in Shumujong. Choose a pair whose total matches the required sum shown above the board. A tile needs an open long side before it can be selected, so the arithmetic also depends on which pieces are accessible.

pages.title: Bug War 2
pages.creator: Flash From The Past
pages.description: Lead an insect colony to victory in Bug War 2. Select one settlement or drag across several, then send their forces toward neutral or enemy colonies. Capture more positions to breed a larger army and gain control over the battlefield.

pages.title: Drop The Gift
pages.creator: Wanted 5 Games B.V.
pages.description: Deliver presents from Santa's sleigh in Drop The Gift. Time each release so a package falls into a chimney as you pass overhead. Watch for birds trying to take the gifts, keeping the sleigh clear of them while continuing the delivery run.

pages.title: MineCity Breakers
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Rampage through a city as an escaped block-style giant in MineCity Breakers. Smash buildings, vehicles, and the military units sent to stop you. Keep advancing through the streets, using attacks and jumps to destroy the obstacles standing in the monster's path.

pages.title: Axes Merge
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Connect axes to create stronger versions in Axes Merge. Draw a line through at least three matching pieces to combine them, then use the resulting tool in later matches. Plan the chain of merges so the board keeps offering another move.

pages.title: A day in the countryside
pages.creator: Black cat games
pages.description: Help a farmer work through the seasons in A day in the countryside. Drive the tractor around the fields and deal with the animals interfering with the job. Continue tending the farmland as the setting changes between seasonal challenges.

pages.title: BBQ Skewers
pages.creator: Simplegame
pages.description: Organize ingredients on sticks in BBQ Skewers. Move the top pieces onto an empty skewer or a matching ingredient, grouping identical food together. Use the spare spaces carefully until each skewer holds one type and the sorting puzzle is complete.

pages.title: Pocket League 3D
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Play football with cars in Pocket League 3D. Drive into the ball to send it toward the opposing goal, jumping for harder hits or using a double jump to flip. Compete alone or with a second player, adding AI teammates when you want a larger match.

pages.title: Mini Rally Racing
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Race miniature cars in Mini Rally Racing. Enter tournaments or choose individual arcade races, competing alone or against a friend on the same keyboard. Use nitro during the race and steer through the track to finish ahead of the other cars.

pages.title: Sliding Blocks
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Send orange blocks toward their marked destinations in Sliding Blocks. A block keeps moving until a wall or obstacle stops it, after which you can choose another direction. Work out the stopping points needed to line up a route to each target square.

pages.title: Ice Princess Pregnant Caring
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Help a princess through a day of pregnancy care in Ice Princess Pregnant Caring. Freshen her up, accompany her to a hospital examination, and prepare dinner after she returns home. Select the objects needed at each stage to complete the day's activities.

pages.title: Potion Ingredient Match
pages.creator: Multoigri
pages.description: Prepare potions by pairing ingredients in Potion Ingredient Match. Find matching items and place them in the two halves of the cauldron before time runs out. Work quickly through successive recipes, since a delay can spoil the potion and interrupt your progress.

pages.title: Animal Puzzle
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Complete animal pictures in Animal Puzzle. Examine the illustration and choose the missing piece that fits its gap, comparing shapes and picture details. Place the correct section to finish the animal image and move on to another visual matching challenge.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Africa
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Clear an African-themed playfield in Bubble Shooter Africa. Aim and fire pieces toward matching items in the arrangement, forming groups that can be removed. Use the available power-ups to handle difficult clusters while working toward clearing the stage.

pages.title: Traffic Racer
pages.creator: ISS Game Studio
pages.description: Drive a yellow sports car along Miami highways in Traffic Racer. Pass checkpoints and collect coins, cash, fuel, and speed boosts as the route continues. Steer around traffic and keep enough fuel to extend the drive toward the next checkpoint.

pages.title: Frozen Slushy Maker
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Prepare icy drinks for a mobile business in Frozen Slushy Maker. Choose flavors and work through the slushy-making steps before serving customers. The game's order-and-delivery setup turns the van into a traveling counter for completing each requested frozen drink.

pages.title: Sultan Match
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Connect matching objects in Sultan Match to reach each level's score requirement. Link groups of at least three identical pieces and keep earning points before the time limit expires. Twelve stages provide a sequence of timed boards to work through.

pages.title: Flappy Birdy
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Keep a bird airborne in Flappy Birdy. Tap to lift it, then let it descend when the route requires a lower position. Adjust the rhythm of the taps to guide the bird through openings without colliding with the pipes.

pages.title: Color Eggs
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Create patterned decorations in Color Eggs. Place a stencil on an egg, dip it in paint, and remove the covering to reveal the design left behind. Experiment with the available patterns and color choices as you work on each egg.

pages.title: Build An Island
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Develop a small stretch of land at sea in Build An Island. Use boats, ships, and construction platforms to work through the island-building tasks. Assemble the structures and vessels step by step as the ocean construction project takes shape.

pages.title: Impossible Tracks Jeep Stunts Driving Game
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Drive a jeep across elevated stunt routes in Impossible Tracks Jeep Stunts Driving Game. Keep the vehicle aligned with the narrow sections and control its speed before each change in the course. The suspended tracks leave little room for recovering from a misplaced wheel.

pages.title: Unicorns Travel The World Puzzle
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Travel between illustrated destinations in Unicorns Travel The World Puzzle. Reassemble jigsaw pictures featuring a unicorn in cities such as Paris, New York, Moscow, and Budapest. Match the scattered pieces to restore each scene and continue through the game's collection of twelve locations.

pages.title: Run Into Death
pages.creator: Game-Devs
pages.description: Defend your home from approaching zombies in Run Into Death. Aim the gun and fire at the undead before they overrun your position. Keep selecting the next threat as more enemies arrive, trying to survive longer than on your previous attempt.

pages.title: Hexa Puzzle
pages.creator: Gamearcade.org
pages.description: Fit hexagonal block pieces into a target outline in Hexa Puzzle. Drag each shape into position, comparing its edges with the spaces still unfilled. Rearrange your choices when necessary until the complete set occupies the required shape.

pages.title: Perfect Sakura Girl
pages.creator: igirlgames
pages.description: Dress Annie for a spring outing in Perfect Sakura Girl. Browse clothing and accessories to create a look for her walk among the flowering cherry trees. Compare the available combinations and finish the outfit before she visits the recreation area.

pages.title: Corona Sweeper
pages.creator: Eery Lab s.c.
pages.description: Locate hidden infected characters in Corona Sweeper, a themed minesweeper puzzle. Work out which board spaces can be cleared and which people need to be quarantined. The goal is to uncover the safe area without triggering the hidden dangers represented by the sick characters.

pages.title: Coloring Book Airplane V 2.0
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Paint cartoon aircraft in Coloring Book Airplane V 2.0. Select a plane picture and choose the colors you want for its body and surrounding details. Fill the drawing a section at a time, then pick another aircraft to give it a different appearance.

pages.title: Shopping Outfits
pages.creator: crazyschoolgames
pages.description: Create outfits for a shopping trip in Shopping Outfits. Combine clothing with shoes, bags, and jewelry for the characters, comparing pieces as you build each look. Finish the styling session by posing with the completed combination of wardrobe choices.

pages.title: Pixel Gun 3D Free Coins and Gems
pages.creator: yaine
pages.description: Spin an on-screen prize wheel in Pixel Gun 3D Free Coins and Gems. Start the wheel and wait for it to stop, then check the selected reward segment. The resource-themed game centers on the outcome of each wheel spin.

pages.title: The coronavirus game
pages.creator: Nicolas Tacgorian
pages.description: Stop a fictional outbreak in The coronavirus game. Apply the game's vaccine attacks to eliminate the spreading virus before it takes over. Collect research points and invest them in improvements, strengthening the in-game vaccine as the challenge continues.

pages.title: Iron Smooth
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Smooth creases from clothing in Iron Smooth. Move the iron across each washed garment to leave the fabric neatly pressed. Guide it around nearby objects, especially the coffee, so the ironing task finishes without knocking the drink over.

pages.title: Die or Dodge
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Jump for diamonds while avoiding insects in Die or Dodge. Move between platforms and time each leap around the enemies sharing the space. A collision ends the run, making each extra diamond a decision about when it is safe to jump.

pages.title: Uphill Climb Bus Driving Simulator Sim 3D
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Carry passengers along hilly roads in Uphill Climb Bus Driving Simulator Sim 3D. Choose a bus and drive toward the destination while keeping the journey under control. Earn cash for vehicle upgrades and use different camera views to judge the route ahead.

pages.title: Valentine Sweet Lover Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Rebuild romantic pictures in Valentine Sweet Lover Puzzle. Choose one of six images and a piece count of sixteen, thirty-six, sixty-four, or one hundred. Match the scattered sections to restore the selected Valentine's scene, using the picture details to guide each connection.

pages.title: Clever Frog
pages.creator: Digi Smile limited
pages.description: Plan a one-way journey across lily pads in Clever Frog. Jump onto every leaf to complete the stage, moving only forward, left, or right. Since the frog cannot jump backward, decide the order of visits before a landing leaves an unreachable leaf behind.

pages.title: Parrot Pal Coloring
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Color eight bird illustrations in Parrot Pal Coloring. Pick a parrot picture, select from twenty-three colors, and fill the drawing with your chosen combination. Add the remaining details and save the finished image when the coloring session is complete.

pages.title: Snow Plow Trucks Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Assemble winter vehicle pictures in Snow Plow Trucks Jigsaw. Choose an easy, medium, or hard layout and move the scattered pieces into their proper positions. Match the truck and snowy background details until the whole photograph is restored.

pages.title: City Car Stunt 2
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Take sports cars into a city stunt setting in City Car Stunt 2. Choose and customize a vehicle, then tackle the driving challenges alone or with a second player. Use steering and nitro controls to handle the urban routes and perform stunts with the selected car.

pages.title: Fidget Spinner Revolution
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Keep a spinner turning in Fidget Spinner Revolution. Build a longer spin and collect coins during the attempts, then spend them on other spinners in the shop. Return with a different design and try to improve how long it stays in motion.

pages.title: Blocky Snake
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Guide a growing block snake along an endless route in Blocky Snake. Steer left and right around obstacles, break blocks for points, and collect body sections to increase its length. Gather coins to unlock more body designs and different environments for future runs.

pages.title: Rugby Rush
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Carry the ball downfield in Rugby Rush. Dodge defenders as you advance toward the try line, collecting bonuses and power-ups along the route. Useful pickups strengthen the runner and add points as you work to get past the final tacklers.

pages.title: Grand Shift Auto
pages.creator: oneru220
pages.description: Roam a crime-themed city in Grand Shift Auto. Take on three missions, buy weapons, and steal vehicles for travel through the streets. The airport adds aircraft to the available transport, letting you switch from driving to flying as you explore the city.

pages.title: Castle Defense 2D
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Defend a fortress with archers in Castle Defense 2D. Shoot arrows at approaching enemies and hold off the waves before they overwhelm the walls. Buy stronger defenses, improve the archers' range, and use special arrow boosts to deal with later attacks.

pages.title: Twisty Lines
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Keep a white ball moving along winding paths in Twisty Lines. Tap to reverse gravity at the right moment, transferring the ball between surfaces as the route changes. Since the ball keeps running, anticipate each corner before it reaches a dangerous gap.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Sports Day
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Help Hazel prepare for a preschool competition in Baby Hazel Sports Day. Practice the activities, then join her friends for events such as the spoon-and-egg race and Frisbee throwing. Respond to the characters' requests as their teams compete for the trophy.

pages.title: Luxury Cars Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Put together photographs of C-Class cars in Luxury Cars Puzzle. Select from six pictures and choose a layout containing sixteen, thirty-six, sixty-four, or one hundred pieces. Connect the matching sections until the vehicle and its surrounding scene are fully restored.

pages.title: EG Air Warfare
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Fly an aircraft through an ongoing battle in EG Air Warfare. Shoot enemy planes while gathering supplies, first-aid kits, and fuel to keep the flight going. More demanding waves arrive as you continue, requiring attention to both incoming threats and the pickups needed to survive.

pages.title: EG Climb Bird
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Help a bird climb past spikes in EG Climb Bird. Tap to fly upward, increasing the ascent speed with faster taps. Collect gems along the way to unlock more characters, but keep the bird clear of the hazards around its route.

pages.title: Hoop Hoop
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Bounce a ball across suspended tiles in Hoop Hoop. Guide it over gaps and through hoops without letting it fall from the course. Jelly cubes launch the ball higher, changing the next landing as you continue toward more distant platforms.

pages.title: Fantasy Battles
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Deploy an army against undead forces in Fantasy Battles. Select units and place them on the battlefield, then observe how the opposing formations fight. Move and rotate the camera to inspect the action before adjusting the forces used in another simulated battle.

pages.title: Reversi Multiplayer
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Compete for control of a board in Reversi Multiplayer. Place discs to trap a line of opposing pieces between your own, flipping the captured discs to your color. Play against the computer, another online player, or a friend sharing the same device.

pages.title: X Trial Racing MA
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Ride a motorcycle over mountain courses in X Trial Racing MA. Control climbs and descents, perform flips, and avoid traps on the way to the checkered flag. Faster finishes earn up to three stars, encouraging another attempt to improve the route and time.

pages.title: Teho Arcade
pages.creator: Tribered Oy
pages.description: Run past monsters and gather useful pickups in Teho Arcade. Jump over threats along the route and use boosters such as a jetpack or magnet to extend the attempt. Keep moving safely through the changing encounters while pursuing a longer run.

pages.title: Marinette Vs Ladybug
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Create two sides of one character's wardrobe in Marinette Vs Ladybug. Choose an everyday outfit for Marinette, then prepare a superhero look for Ladybug. Compare the clothing and accessories available for each role before completing both versions of her style.

pages.title: Pottery Store
pages.creator: Csharks Games & Solutions Pvt Ltd.
pages.description: Help Felicia run a pottery-painting business in Pottery Store. Match each customer's requested colors and designs, then pack and sell the finished pot. Spend the income on additional pots, patterns, and shop upgrades to support the next round of orders.

pages.title: Angry Chickens
pages.creator: Red Eye Production
pages.description: Grow a trailing flock in Angry Chickens. Steer the chicken around the playfield and consume rivals to become longer, looking for openings around the other moving chickens. Manage the growing body's route as you try to increase its size further.

pages.title: The Halloween Breaker
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Clear a Halloween-themed grid in The Halloween Breaker. Select connected groups of two or more matching blocks to remove them and rearrange the board. Clicking a lone block costs a life, so look for combinations that leave fewer isolated pieces behind.

pages.title: Quick Sudoku
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Fill a number grid against the clock in Quick Sudoku. Select a difficulty and place digits so every row, column, and marked box satisfies the Sudoku rules. Work through the remaining possibilities before the time limit expires to complete the puzzle.

pages.title: Hero Rush
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Drive through an obstacle-filled road in Hero Rush. Change lanes, jump over barriers, and collect money or boosts along the way. Time each maneuver around the cars ahead so the vehicle can continue through another stretch of the run.

pages.title: Angela Twins Family Day
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Help Angela and Tom look after two kittens in Angela Twins Family Day. Clear dirty diapers, laundry, and scattered toys from the room, then prepare milk for the babies. Continue responding to the kittens' needs after the house has been cleaned and organized.

pages.title: Cindy Cooking Cupcakes
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Decorate desserts for Emma in Cindy Cooking Cupcakes. Help Cindy choose ingredients and finishing touches for cupcakes and ice cream in the kitchen. Combine the available toppings in your preferred style to complete the sweets for her daughter.

pages.title: Ice Queen Pool Day
pages.creator: DariaGames.com
pages.description: Style a royal character for a summer outing in Ice Queen Pool Day. Choose a swimsuit, compare shoes, and add accessories to finish her poolside look. Browse the available pieces and put together the combination you want her to wear for the day.
